help_support_screen.faq_track_order_q: How do I track my order?

how_to_measure.body:
Chest - around the fullest part of your bust, tape parallel to the floor.
Waist - around the narrowest part, usually just above the belly button.
Hip - around the fullest part of your hips, about 20 cm below your waist.
how_to_measure.kids_shoes: Place your child's foot flat on paper, trace it and measure heel to toe in cm. Add 0.5 cm for growing room.
how_to_measure.baby: Babies grow quickly - if between sizes, size up for longer wear.
how_to_measure.kids_height: Measure your child's height standing straight against a wall without shoes.
how_to_measure.ring: Wrap a strip of paper around the base of your finger. Mark where it overlaps and measure the length in mm - that is your circumference.
how_to_measure.bed: The size refers to the mattress. For bedding (sheets, duvets, covers), choose the same size as your mattress.
how_to_measure.belt: Measure around your trouser waist in cm (where you wear your belt). Your belt size = your waist measurement + 5 cm.
